The same positive metric symmetrizes both iff (for nondegenerate c,s) 2g1=(2-z)g2, feasible precisely z<2; the supplied diagonal G also covers degenerate admissible endpoints. Exact z=3 matrices have negative trace -5/3, independently excluding a common metric. Checker executed; finite evaluations supplement the all-z proof.
